best_for: Web developers on Windows or Mac who want Firefox's newest DevTools next to their everyday browser, without the two sharing a profile.

points.title: Runs beside regular Firefox
points.text: It installs to its own path with its own profile, so it sits next to Firefox Release or Beta. Your daily bookmarks and extensions stay out of your test browser, and the other way round.

points.title: Set up for development
points.text: Browser and remote debugging are switched on from the start, along with a dark theme and a toolbar button for the tools. You skip the usual round of preference changes.

points.title: Pre-release code
points.text: Mozilla describes it as carrying the latest developer tools in beta, and the Mac build listed here is a beta release. Expect the odd bug, and keep a stable browser for banking and daily work.

points.title: Old systems are left out
points.text: Windows 8.1 and earlier and macOS 10.14 and earlier are no longer supported. Mozilla points those machines to Firefox ESR.

points.title: Free and open source
points.text: Like all Firefox builds it costs nothing and is released under the Mozilla Public License 2.0.

points.title: What this site keeps
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 196 versions, with machine-wide installers for x86, x64 and Arm64. macOS lists only the current universal build, so a Mac downgrade needs another source. Linux builds exist on Mozilla's site but are not listed here.
